svg.text: S3 + Amplify Hosting — static website (manual deployment)
cdk deploy uploads the zipped site, a custom-resource Lambda hands Amplify a presigned S3 URL, and Amplify serves the content from its managed CDN
Changed site files -> new CDK asset hash -> a new object is presigned
-> the next cdk deploy triggers a fresh Amplify deployment.
AwsCustomResource cannot presign (static parameters at synth time),
so a Lambda-backed custom-resource Provider is used.
5 fetches the zip over HTTPS (presigned URL)
